title: events
description: Result of `stride events` — projected CTL/ATL/TSB on each event date (ADR 0010: the arithmetic consequences of the recorded open plan, never a proposed one). The projection folds Metrics.load_step forward from the last computed daily_load row; each open session with a structured target contributes the load its kind prices to (Metrics.projected_load, ADR 0019: power TSS, pace rTSS, heart-rate hrTSS, session-RPE load), and every other day is filled from the athlete's own history and labeled (ADR 0022): a session no target prices by its estimate, a day with no session at the recent daily mean, a session typed rest at zero. load_sources counts the days by source. baseline_known false = no computed history, every number is decay over zero. ftp_known false = no 60d best-20min power, so power targets do not price their sessions (each is listed in its event's unprojected as no_ftp).

days_away.description: Days until the event from the local today. Negative = the event has passed: ctl/atl/tsb then echo the CURRENT baseline, not a projection — daily_load holds the event-day reading.

sessions_projected.description: How many of those carried a target the projection could price. unprojected names each of the others and why; the days they fall on are estimated from history unless typed rest, as load_sources counts.

plan_end.description: The written plan's last day before the event, projected the same way, when the plan stops short of the event: past that day every day is filled from the athlete's recent training. It is the horizon the window's event card projects to when the event is more than 42 days away, and `stride project <date>` returns the same numbers for it. known false (date empty, numbers 0) when the plan reaches the event day or nothing is planned ahead.

unprojected.description: Each session in (projected_from, event_date] whose target adds no load of its own, with why, the same entries `stride project` lists: no_target, no_ftp, no_hr_zones, no_threshold_pace. planned_in_window minus sessions_projected counts them.

target_literal.description: The session's target in canonical form; empty when it has none.

load_sources.description: The days from projected_from to the event day counted by where their load came from, as `stride project` counts them (target, estimate, habit, rest, none); they sum to the days projected.
